contractorPerf.title: Contractor performance
contractorPerf.note: Worked out automatically from the delay days of the issues, the snags, the quality results, the Procurement orders and the contract end. Nothing is typed. The thresholds are set in Settings, Registers, Contractors.

healthBands.invalid: Green is a whole number from 1 to 100, amber a whole number from 0 to 99, and green must be above amber.

npp.reason_quiet_mail: E-mail not sent in quiet time
npp.org_dnd: People may use a scheduled do-not-disturb

npp.dnd_note: E-mail and device alerts are held during this window on the chosen days. Mandatory notices still arrive.

dsi.title: Document search index
dsi.note: Global search finds words inside uploaded PDF and Word (DOCX) files, not only file names. The text is read in the background every few minutes from files that passed the virus scan, so a new upload becomes searchable shortly after. Old files are indexed the same way. Results respect your documents permission and regions. Images, spreadsheets and other formats are searched by name only.

regrules.title: Register rules
regrules.note: Rules the database enforces for one register, for example that an invoice must name its Procurement order. Every change needs a reason and is audited.
